claims.title: Exact conditional sampling from a bounded-energy Gaussian source has a sharp copy optimum
claims.claim: For each integer s>=1, h=4s^2, let B0=[[1/4,0],[0,0]] and B1=[[1/4,1/(4s)],[1/(4s),0]] define normalized pure Gaussian states. Both formulas are known but label i is hidden. For independent unconditional copies, an always-output procedure realizing exactly the second-mode count law conditional on first-mode count h for either source has minimum fixed budget N*=ceil(log Z_h/(-log F_h)), where A_j=product_{r=0}^{j-1}(1-2r/h)^2, Z_h=sum_{j=0}^{h/2} A_j/(2j)!, and F_h=sqrt(1-(8h-1)/(15h^2)) is the SQUARED pure-state overlap. N*/h -> (15/4)log(cosh 1)=1.626678... . P0=delta_0; P1(2j)=A_j/((2j)!Z_h).
claims.interface: Unknown label; copies are the only source-dependent resource. Arbitrary collective/adaptive measurements are allowed; label-bearing advice, preparation-unitary access and conditional-state oracles are excluded. Output law is assessed unconditionally, charging failures. TV(P,Q)=1/2 sum|P-Q| and quantum trace distance=1/2||rho-sigma||_1. Integer h is restricted to 4s^2.
claims.proof_spine: The zero-output effect must fix source 0, forcing F_h^N<=1/Z_h. Vacuum/nonvacuum detection in mode 2 has no-click probability F_h^N under source 1; rebalancing positive output mass attains the criterion. Integer boundaries reduce to the rational inequality [1-(8h-1)/(15h^2)]^N Z_h^2<=1. Geometric proposals for the known positive law use rational acceptance 2^J A_J/(2J)!.
claims.costs: Unconditional input mean photon count <=1/4; conditional output mean <=sinh(1). With label supplied, exact sampling uses <=4/3 expected proposals and expected bit work polynomial in log h. Exact acquisition rebalancing setup is polynomial in h, with O(h log h)-bit operands; copy optimality is not classical-runtime optimality. At TV<=1/12 fixed copies need N>=5h/96; almost-sure termination with adaptive count needs max_i E_i T>=5h/9216. Exact fair-bit algorithms have no bounded worst-case random-bit claim.
claims.failure: One heralded attempt can use one copy; its success probability cannot be discarded. The fixed-budget exact optimum does not apply to expected-copy budgets or arbitrary devices without this promise. Sufficiency assumes ideal independent preparations and ideal vacuum detection. No quantum hardware or physical acquisition was demonstrated.
claims.comparator: Two-state quantum discrimination/fidelity mechanisms are established prior art. The exact Gaussian operational witness and complete interface have unresolved historical priority.
claims.gate: Obtain independent expert or formal review of the exact fixed-copy criterion, algebraic rebalancing coin and expected-bit sampler; determine priority of the exact witness without claiming novelty of discrimination.
claims.related_scope: Acquisition boundary for supplied-model conditional computation; does not refute either earlier supplied-model theorem.

claims.title: A supplied positive Gaussian single-herald compiler extends to nonnegative displacement
claims.claim: For an explicitly supplied rational symmetric entrywise nonnegative 2m-by-2m Bargmann kernel K, nonnegative rational displacement ell, ket/bra exchange symmetry, rho(XK)<1, one nonzero-probability herald h encoded in binary, and error epsilon, the internal construction samples remaining physical counts to TV<=epsilon in bit work polynomial in complete input length, m, log(h+1), log(1/epsilon), with certified polynomial-time elementary evaluations. Physicality of the density operator is an additional supplied promise. Uniform complexity of the particular Python/Arb refinement implementation remains unproved.
claims.interface: One physical herald, binary output counts, rational nonnegative K and ell, normalizability and physicality. X exchanges ket/bra blocks. No arbitrary complex/signed kernels or multiple herald modes. Supplied exact parameters are not acquired from a device. The zero-displacement baseline and displaced extension have distinct endpoint/error allocations.
claims.proof_spine: Schur elimination leaves [[a,b],[b,a]] with singleton weights (c,c). Cross-count weights w(k)=b^k H_(h-k)(a,c)^2/k!, H_n=[z^n]exp(a z^2/2+c z). Each parity subsequence is log-concave, though the full law need not be. Approximate ratio anchors plus factor-two inflation combine two envelopes without parity normalizers, total envelope mass <=12 times target mass. Conditional own-pair laws have decreasing ratios. Source Poisson and aggregate reverse-Schur binomial/negative-binomial draws reconstruct counts; N537 supplies coefficient evaluation.
claims.costs: No enumeration of h photons. Graph/routing operations and scalar-call bound O(m^3); rational pivot and large-count bit lengths, precision, capped tickets, rejection/fallback events and TV budget are charged. Final displaced endpoint allocates epsilon/4 to tickets and 3epsilon/4 across at most max_scalar_calls+4 scalar draws. Source reports undisplaced h=10^100 and displaced h=10^20 runs; these are finite observations, not uniform runtime or fastest-software evidence.
claims.failure: Full-law unimodality is refuted at h=2,a=1/4,b=7/40,c=1/100; parity splitting bypasses this failure without making that counterexample obsolete. Earlier displaced_gate.txt says no route had then been established; final followup establishes an internal constructive route. Only repaired endpoint APIs have the audited integer/ticket contract. Historical broad software tests precede final narrow evaluator repairs; final hashes and targeted regressions must be read together. No physical preparation/calibration, finite-sample verification of tiny TV error, formal or external validation is supplied.
claims.comparator: Extends Astra N417/N418 at a scoped supplied-model interface. Gaussian moments, trinomial bridges, generic log-concave rejection and loop/path representations have prior art; complete compiler priority is UNKNOWN.
claims.gate: Close the uniform precision-refinement runtime gap for the actual numerical endpoint and independently review the full encoded TV contract and final-code audit lineage.
claims.related_scope: Source-reported extension and endpoint audits of positive single-herald supplied-model sampling; original claims/statuses remain intact.

claims.title: Positive parity-folded Gaussian moments admit binary-index logarithmic coefficient evaluation
claims.claim: For all rational a,c>=0, binary integer n>=0, p>=1, H_n=[z^n]exp(a z^2/2+c z) can be recognized as zero or log H_n enclosed with absolute width <=2^-p in deterministic bit work polynomial in rational input length, log(n+1), and p. An expanded exact rational coefficient is not promised; it may require Omega(n) bits.
claims.interface: Nonnegative rational coefficients and a logarithmic interval/scaled mantissa-exponent output; exact zeros and elementary a=0 or c=0 cases handled separately. The mathematical algorithm and the actual adaptive Arb implementation have distinct complexity statuses. Symbols a,c,n and center u below are local.
claims.proof_spine: For a,c>0, d=c/sqrt(a), sigma=(-1)^n, u=(d+sqrt(d^2+4n))/2: H_n=a^(n/2)/(n!sqrt(2pi)) integral_0^infinity t^n exp(-(t-d)^2/2)[1+sigma exp(-2dt)]dt. Fold parity before approximation; odd factor uses -expm1(-2dt). Normalize at u, use a uniform positive integral lower bound, Gaussian tails, and bounded complex extension. Certified Taylor quadrature or independently justified rational interpolation gives polynomial precision/cost. Use u-d=n/u to control cancellation in log prefactors. Small n uses a short positive finite sum.
claims.costs: For retained radius R=O(sqrt(p)), rational panels width 1/2 and q+1 equally spaced nodes give pointwise error <=(128/3)(2/3)^(q+1), total weight <=2R(2e)^q; q=O(p+log R), polynomial guard precision. Cancellation in prefactors needs O(log n) extra precision. Does not promise a polynomial-sized expanded coefficient or uniform runtime of a particular library.
claims.failure: Signed saddle subtraction can lose tiny odd displacement; the positive folding route avoids that obstruction. Relative error for H_n and absolute width for log H_n need explicit precision conversion; they are not the same quantity. Source code/audits remain ordinary model-assisted numerical evidence, not formal/expert certification.
claims.comparator: Gaussian moments/Hermite and parabolic-cylinder quantities and the integral identity are classical. Originality of the uniform complete encoded interface remains UNKNOWN.
claims.gate: Independently certify uniform analytic/bit-cost bounds and audit the implemented Taylor recurrence, guard precision and final domain repairs; resolve prior art for the encoded evaluation contract.
claims.related_scope: Reusable coefficient interface; no automatic application to signed or complex coefficients.
